hero.title: Activities to book
hero.description: Experiences that need a booking or advance planning. Day-by-day details are in the itinerary.

activities.title: Owl Cafe Akiba Fukurou (booked)
activities.description: BOOKED - Sunday Oct 25 at 14:00. Arrive 10 min early. 67 Kanda Neribeicho, 3 min from JR Akihabara (Central Gate).

activities.title: Tokyo Skytree at sunset
activities.description: Tembo Deck + Tembo Galleria ticket (the highest, 450 m), timed slot around 16:30 on Sunday Oct 25 (sunset ~16:50). Buy online now: weekend sunset slots go fast.

activities.title: Warner Bros. Studio Tour Tokyo - Harry Potter
activities.description: BOOK FIRST. Tuesday Oct 27, slot around 10:00, ~4h on site. Timed tickets on the official website only, non-refundable (adult ~JPY 7,000). Arrive 20 min before the slot.

activities.title: Small Worlds Tokyo
activities.description: Wednesday Oct 28 around 10:30, ~2h. Open 9:00-19:00 (last entry 18:00). Online ticket recommended.

activities.title: Shinjuku night walk (booked)
activities.description: BOOKED (Japan Experience) - Sunday Nov 8, 18:30-20:00, in English. Meet outside Uniqlo Shinjuku West Exit (under renovation): look for the Japan Experience sign. Arrive 10 min early, the group leaves on time. May be cancelled in bad weather.

activities.title: Ogakiku - eel in Kawagoe
activities.description: Monday Nov 9. No bookings: arrive before opening (11:00 on weekdays, lunch until 14:00). Closed on Thursdays. Unaju JPY 3,950 to 6,500. Closes early if the eel runs out.

activities.title: Daisetsuzan Ropeway
activities.description: Panoramic cable car. Operation depends on weather, heavy crowds in high season.

activities.title: Ainu Village - Ikahchu Show
activities.description: Ainu dance and music show in the evening. Limited sessions, booking recommended.

activities.title: Boat on Lake Akan
activities.description: Lake tour with a visit to the Marimo Exhibition Center.

activities.title: Canoe on Lake Akan
activities.description: Optional. Book with local operators on arrival or in advance.

activities.title: Farm Tomita
activities.description: Lavender fields and Melon House. Free entry, check seasonal opening.

activities.title: Ningle Terrace
activities.description: Craft village in the Furano forest. Best in the evening, check opening hours.
